text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
That was a... wonderful race.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Duramente-san.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I want to reach these heights soon too. And one day, with you as well.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...There's no need to rush.
Your career is only just beginning, after all—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will continue to grow even stronger going forward.
As a senior who guides you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —You've really developed a great expression on your face.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Do you really think so?
I cannot see my own face, so I cannot tell."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: My girl's expression has softened quite a bit, too. It really brings a rush of emotion to my heart.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mo・ther.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (—This isn't so bad. Things like this.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Alve-chan.
Good work today~.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Good work.

text_block_list.name: Mirako's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mirako!
Isn't being that laid-back taking it a bit too far against Alv-san?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
I'm telling you, I'm totally fine~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Alv-chan really is so cool.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, I'm still totally laid-back.
Never changing is probably just who I am."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: So I'll just keep being my usual laid-back self.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm just going into this with a casual mindset like,
"It'd be nice if I could become someone's dream!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Aah, hey, don't leave me behind~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: By the time we returned to the front of the academy, the sun had already set—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um...!
Alv-san!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Rob Roy-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um, today was—a great race!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Yes, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: In my heroic tale, there are still great battles yet to come.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I will make sure to finish writing this autumn's story...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Until we run together again.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
!
Universe-san...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: Is there something else going on...?
Is there something else going on...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "singularity" that overturns the "fixed event"...
The "soul" that has been "repaired"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Admire Groove is... no longer... subject to interference from "causality".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: We can aim for any "coordinates"... right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I believe Rob Roy-san wants to run with you again.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm okay now, really.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
"Thank you."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "It means... no matter which path I take, I can advance according to my own will."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
“—Naturally, our next goal has already been decided.
The 'Queen Elizabeth II Cup'... and winning it back-to-back.”

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Combining the experience gained from the Triple Tiara
with its glory—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (I want to leave a distinct hoofprint behind for Duramente-san...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I want to convey my gratitude to Air Groove-san
and her mother, the trainer, for welcoming me.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (And then—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: To you, too... just a little.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "Regardless, from here on—I just have to keep heading down the path where hope leads."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking up at the clear night sky as she said that,
her profile appeared utterly radiant.
